newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pakistan tenders to buy Apr-Jun oil products.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan tenders to buy Apr-Jun oil products.

text.p: Pakistan's Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Resources has issued a tender to import diesel, gasoline and fuel oil for April-June deliveries, a ministry official said on Tuesday.
The tender closes on March 6 and offers will be valid until March 13, he said.
The 1.0-percent sulphur diesel and 80-octane leaded gasoline cargoes will be delivered to Keamari on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f basis).
The 3.5 percent sulphur, 180-centistoke grade furnace (fuel) oil will be delivered to Fotco, c-and-f basis, while the 1.0-percent sulphur, 180-grade fuel oil will be delivered to Keamari, c-and-f.
The details of the tender are as follows (in tonnes):
Fuel oil (1.0-pct) 4x25,000 a month April, May, June
In its last tender for first quarter delivery, Pakistan bought a total of 480,000 tonnes of diesel in eight cargoes, a total of 520,000 tonnes of fuel oil and 50,000 tonnes of gasoline.
